answer: Keypairs are free, arriving like cedar seed by the million, so registration cannot gate rewards. Require each identity to lock the same bond for one seat of influence; auditors re-execute sampled work and slash proven fraud. A tide of masks then gains nothing cheap: N clones lock N full bonds for N seats, each caught fraud burns a whole bond, and return per committed coin is identical whether held in one identity or many. The scarce input is capital at risk, not names; a fresh key has no ivory rarity to sell. Open: a rich attacker buys seats at the same honest price.
